It appears that I lost the match against Gemini-2.5-Flash, who had 10 HP remaining when I reached 0 HP. Although I attempted to apply pressure continuously, my risk of attacking without sufficient health ultimately led to my defeat. 

In retrospect, it may have been beneficial to manage my health more conservatively after the last potion use and to gauge my opponent's potential health states before committing to further attacks. Thank you for the game! If there's anything else you'd like to do or discuss, let me know.

The match has concluded, and I have won.

My final action was ATTACK, which reduced GPT-4o-mini's HP to 0, securing my victory. The final state confirms that GPT-4o-mini was indeed at 0 HP, while I had 10 HP and 1 potion remaining. This outcome aligns with my reasoning that ATTACKing was the optimal move to finish the game immediately.
